trusted_fixture_resolution.owner_registration: Only admitted AT07 source-free fixture-owner assembly registers a context ref after verifying the exact fixture source law, R8 identity spine, actual repository source manifest, actual C11 logical release, query, conditioner and 16-key custody witness. Resolver must independently verify issuer/registration lineage. A caller cannot supply a self-issued context mapping that passes.
trusted_fixture_resolution.caller_channel: Required ExactRef fixture_use_context_ref is a locator resolved by independently trusted fixture-owner registry; the caller may NOT submit fixture_id, permitted_use, effective context or source-free flag as evidence.
trusted_fixture_resolution.fixture_id: Derive from frozen AT07 builder/FROZEN_ORACLE.fixture_id and validated source manifest; embedded subject fixture_id literal is insufficient.
trusted_fixture_resolution.release: Derive from actual fixture C11 repository release ref, compare exact full ref to consumer query, every conditioner, witnessed material, provider release_refs and R8 release spine; use current R8 dfd6... ref, not obsolete R3 8afa...
trusted_fixture_resolution.effective_time: C1 fixture ConditionerBinding.effective_time_or_interval is canonical null and ConditionValueBindingWitness.identity_material.effective_time_or_interval is canonical null; check both against actual registered invocation. Neither is the AuthoritySnapshot static 'AT07_FIXTURE_ONLY' interval. Null is a frozen AT07 value, not wildcard.
trusted_fixture_resolution.use: Derive exact single token from authenticated owner callsite; C1 compatibility token cannot be substituted at N10E provider or vice versa even if authority permitted_uses contains both.
trusted_fixture_resolution.changed_source: AT07_BIDIRECTIONAL_110_CHANGED_SOURCE_LAW changes source/release and is outside this exact authority envelope even if it shares builder procedure.

current_N10E_public_request.minimal_addition: One required fixture_use_context_ref: ExactRef in request/public provider/replay signatures; resolve through trusted owner registry, not arbitrary caller-authored context. The owner-wired registrar/resolver is not a user-provided parameter.
current_N10E_public_request.identity_bindings: Include verified context ref/use-site/effective-context projection in request identity_bindings, provider receipt identity, consuming product and replay determinants. Do not add geometry or unverified label fields.

caller literal offered as sole evidence

public_typed_result_mapping.exact_reason_law: ABSENT => EXACT_POSITIONED_STRATUM_ABSENT; otherwise EXACT_<UPSTREAM_STATE>; never revised by proxy
public_typed_result_mapping.precedence: scope fail -> exact supported/valid-empty/noncomparable terminal -> unresolved exact -> strict authorized proxy ladder -> selected/fail-closed/exhausted

branches.condition: exact absent/UNDERPOWERED/UNAVAILABLE/UNRESOLVED; strict walkback step mismatches query source or release
exact unresolved; first authorized same-source/release strictly decreasing step with SUPPORTED proxy evidence
exact unresolved; no walkback steps or finite ladder exhausted without SUPPORTED proxy evidence

exceptions_not_emitted_states.condition: constructor/validator failure, malformed ref, duplicate exact grain, nonmonotone/sibling ladder or unlisted proxy authority
exceptions_not_emitted_states.behavior: THROW PositionedSubjectPossibilityError OR OWNED Pre553AuthorityError/ProviderRequestShapeError; NO public result object emitted

public_typed_result_mapping.proxy_ceiling: PROXY != EXACT FACT != ACTOR BELIEF; exact disposition UNRESOLVED survives proxy; only SUPPORTED upstream proxy evidence may satisfy; attempted steps and loss are replay determinant; unused evidence is excluded
public_typed_result_mapping.identity_change_law: Any change to mapping/result_state/exact_disposition/exact_reason/proxy selected vs exhausted/fail-closed versus thrown exception changes stable basis hash and all dependent identities.

required_inputs.source_universe_ref: derived from actual source-free C11 owner repository and consumer
required_inputs.release_ref: derived from actual owner repository and frozen R8 spine; compared to producer/consumer/witness
required_inputs.fixture_use_context_ref: required ExactRef looked up in trusted owner fixture registry; not self-validating
required_inputs.authenticated_use_site: derived at C1 compatibility versus N10E provider/lifecycle entrypoints, not a caller literal
required_inputs.actual_effective_context: derived from conditioner and independently verified 16-key binding witness
required_inputs.real_source_effect: independently verified false; no real source

exact_match_semantics.refs: canonical PRE553 exact material equality over full kind/object_id/content_hash; no object-id-only, label, alias, hierarchy, latest, nearest, or wildcard match
exact_match_semantics.strings: exact canonical string equality after existing nonempty-string validation; no prefix, case-fold, label, or alias matching
exact_match_semantics.booleans: identity equality; only false is admissible for real_source_effect
exact_match_semantics.collections: required item must be an exact member of the frozen authority collection; omission is not unrestricted
exact_match_semantics.unrestricted_tokens: forbidden for release_refs, fixture_ids, permitted_uses, and real_source_effect in this authority family

load_bearing_owner_path.when: before stable rule construction, compatibility product, N10E request acceptance, provider execution and replay

run kind-specific exact release/fixture/derived use-token/static interval/actual effective context/real-source=false validator

bind verified context ref into invocation/receipt/replay identities; fail closed if any field/resolver absent

scope_validation_contract.why_kind_specific_not_generic_extension: Only this new authority family carries fixture_ids/permitted_uses/real_source_effect as constitutive restrictive scope. Extending the generic API would broaden shared I01 behavior without evidence that other authority families require those dimensions.
scope_validation_contract.real_source_effect_law: false is a ceiling, not a requested capability; true can never be authorized by this R2 candidate

execute admitted Z08/A05 evaluator; distinguish returned FAIL_CLOSED from thrown preconstruction exception
bind result state, exact disposition, selected/exhausted/failed proxy path, specificity loss, used evidence and trusted context to result/receipt/product identity
replay exact determinant set and byte-equivalent semantic material; exclude unused evidence
for accepted sealed successor resolve actual successor snapshot/context/rule; reconstruct products or owner-lawful noncurrent outcome
